comparison_markers: ## Upstream Delta Since the Previous Pin

delta_decisions.upstream_change: embedding and native media
delta_decisions.rationale: DirectML serialization, EmbeddingGemma2/media and model-wrapper changes belong to upstream embedding owners. The fork keeps canonical CPU MiniLM/FastEmbed provenance and model/dimension checks; no model, media interface, accelerator or benchmark claim changes. Any model change retains the independent code/text gates.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: integration history
delta_decisions.rationale: Merge history integrates the behavior groups below. Remerge resolutions in palace writes, normalization, search, backend helpers and filesystem helpers were inspected with Git; they are assessed at the final frozen source rather than treated as independent features. No merge or history contract is imported.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: retrieval and time
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has normalized LanceDB vectors and its own deterministic code ranking. Upstream multi-backend cosine scales, closet boosts, BM25 union/ties and timezone/date-window contracts are not the same interface. No ranking migration, benchmark equivalence or new time-filter capability is claimed.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: source mining and replacement
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream source formats, registry rows, quick-check shortcuts, general-mode rewrites and media/daemon forwarding differ from fork scanner and generated-copy policy. Exact source replacement is assessed separately; no broad parser or ingest-version migration is imported.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: alternative backend storage
delta_decisions.rationale: Chroma/raw-SQLite, sqlite_exact, Rust, remote backend filters/vector validation and backend-specific stored-text escaping have no corresponding current storage backend in this LanceDB-only package. The fork does not gain those dependencies or backend contracts.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: mcp protocol and server
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream capability refactoring, HTTP locks/tokens, light PQL facade, revision logs and tunnel bookkeeping are separate owners and interfaces. The fork retains its typed stdio registry and no update_drawer/revision-log or HTTP service. Shared argument-validation safety is assessed in its own group; no blanket protocol equivalence is claimed.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: configuration and state publication
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has its own configuration, atomic publication and lock owners. Upstream shared fsio, Windows retry, alternate YAML naming, environment parser and path consolidation are not copied wholesale. Existing invalid-registry and backup/restore refusal evidence remains scoped to its actual owners, without claiming equivalent behavior for every upstream state file.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: release documentation and ci
delta_decisions.rationale: The projects have independent release versions, Python ranges, lint rules, Docker/native artifacts and CI. Upstream3.12.0 requires Python3.10; this fork retains its reviewed3.11-3.14 matrix. Upstream export/removed onboarding information updates the comparison only and does not change fork commands.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: optional upstream maintenance
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream closets, AAAK collections, wing aliases/splitting, format miners, persistent tunnels and short-drawer dedup retirement are not imported. Fork cleanup keeps its manual/unique data protections and receipt-bound migration. New upstream maintenance semantics do not authorize deletion or reorganization here.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: network and process routing
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork exposes stdio MCP and local watcher ownership, without upstream hub, daemon forwarding, HTTP proxy or mesh. Upstream token/proxy/browser and process-routing changes have no such reachable surface in this release.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: agent hooks
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream hook interpreter routing, asynchronous checkpointing and Hermes diary ownership are outside the fork default code-question workflow. This review neither enables conversation persistence nor changes global client instructions or hook installation.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: entity name preservation
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork reproduced silent entity-name collisions at its legacy normalized IDs. Its existing KG owner now refuses distinct names before writes, import, invalidation and name-scoped reads, with transaction and snapshot guards. Existing IDs and schema stay unchanged. Upstream punctuation-preserving new IDs and property-merge semantics are not imported; the pre-existing add_entity property-replacement contract remains separate.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: conversation fidelity
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork uses per-source content hashes, explicit decoding refusal and its own transcript rendering/chunking contracts. Upstream branch selection, transform stamps, multipart rendering and cross-file conversation migration are not asserted as identical. No conversation corpus was inspected or re-mined for this review.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: external model consent
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no upstream LLM client, closet generator or OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint. Upstream now defaults its LLM client to local Ollama and requires consent for external endpoints; API credentials are not intrinsic to local reranking. No external-model feature is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: graph path and import policy
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already resolves its palace-owned SQLite KG through open_palace_kg and a guarded legacy-adoption owner. Upstream graph-selection and import-conflict policy are different durable contracts; automatic graph switching, merging and a new import command are not added. The confirmed name collision in the local adoption path is fixed in the separate preservation group.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: shared mcp argument guards
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already validates required strings, booleans, enums, ranges, text bounds, unknown arguments and sanitized handler failures in its dispatcher. Its existing real stdio regressions exercise refusal and continued service. No upstream coercion or network-token contract is copied.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: atomic source replacement
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork add_drawers_batch delegates changed-source replacement to one LanceDB composite merge. Failure leaves old source rows and manual rows outside the replacement scope. Existing source-failure and storage merge regressions are the evidence; upstream closet/AAAK cleanup contracts are absent.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: source decoding policy
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream now carries stray bytes and records transforms through its own wire/storage paths. The fork refuses undecodable sources instead of filing replacement characters. A reversible stored-text representation would change its durable contract and requires separate acceptance; no such migration is introduced.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: verbatim spellcheck policy
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already passes spellcheck=False for supported conversation mining and preserves code identifiers. Upstream opt-in spell correction and transform stamps are not enabled; the existing local predicates establish the refusal to silently spell-correct.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Windows HTTP hub port exclusivity
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream reserves its Windows HTTP hub port with SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE to prevent another server from receiving hub connections and Authorization headers. The fork exposes stdio MCP through its existing launcher and dispatcher and has no HTTP hub or listening socket on this path. No HTTP transport or socket state owner is introduced.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: transactional SQLite hallway store and per-wing updates
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream imports persistent hallway JSON into SQLite on first write, retains the imported source, pages reads and updates only the mined wing. Mixed upstream versions can still write retired JSON. This fork has no persistent hallway sidecar or hallway migration route; its graph owner derives room relationships from LanceDB metadata. Persistent hallway storage and its lifecycle remain outside this release.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: chore(deps): bump pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish from 1.14.2 to 1.14.3 (#2878)
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork pins the official signed v1.14.3 commit 7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 in its existing trusted-publishing workflow. This fixes critical GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 in the TLS trust store used by publishing and attestations. Permissions, triggers and artifact ownership are unchanged. The existing regression checks the sole trusted-publisher route; the exact action pin is also checked against the official signed tag and advisory.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: perf(backends): add iter_metadata to sqlite_exact/qdrant and Qdrant scroll pagination (#2745)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream adds metadata streams and scroll pagination to its SQLiteExact/Qdrant/Chroma collection owners. The fork uses LanceDB through mempalace_code/storage.py and its existing mining metadata path; it does not ship these upstream collection backends. No backend or metadata state owner is introduced.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(kg): don't cap the length of values the KG tools only look up (#2911)
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork KG lookup, timeline and invalidation schemas and backend paths impose no creation-value length cap on stored names. A disposable backend API probe queried, timelined and invalidated a 4096-character entity successfully. The named existing regressions cover ordinary lookup, invalidation and timeline behavior; no new long-value regression or real stdio 4096-character exercise is claimed. The source and backend evidence establish equivalent local behavior for this upstream lookup fix.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: feat(http): timestamp MCP log file + per-call wait/run timing (#2882)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream timestamps HTTP MCP logs and measures per-call queue/run time. The fork MCP entrypoint is stdio; HTTP logging and queue timing are not part of its dispatcher or stdout contract. No HTTP transport or logging owner is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(daemon): emit lifecycle and HTTP access lines to stdout/stderr (#2475) (#2607)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream changes lifecycle and HTTP access output in its HTTP daemon. The fork has no corresponding HTTP daemon; its watcher and stdio owners retain their existing logging and lifecycle contracts.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(repair-status): tell a healthy unflushed palace from one that lost its index (#2525)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream distinguishes Chroma HNSW flushed/pending searchable coverage from a lost index. The fork retires Chroma runtime storage and uses LanceDB health/repair owners; it has no paired chroma.sqlite3/HNSW recovery contour to amend.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test(embeddinggemma2): skip scipy-dependent audio tests when scipy is absent (#2901)
delta_decisions.rationale: This upstream test-only change skips audio tests without scipy for EmbeddingGemma2. The fork canonical runtime is CPU FastEmbed MiniLM and it does not ship that EmbeddingGemma2/audio test surface.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test(daemon): lock #2673 module-level retention contract (#2896)
delta_decisions.rationale: This upstream regression test pins its HTTP daemon module-retention contract. The fork watcher/process retention has separate existing owners and no dependency on that upstream daemon module contract.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test(mcp): pin #2748 coexisting case-variant wing rename (#2883)
delta_decisions.rationale: This upstream test-only change covers coexisting case-variant wings in its MCP rename tool. The fork does not expose that upstream rename-tool implementation; its existing wing migration and naming behavior remain separate.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(mine): honour .git/info/exclude and skip .worktrees/.claude worktrees (#2599) (#2794)
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork scanner already refuses unrequested nested Git repositories and linked worktrees, including those under agent worktree directories, so the demonstrated duplicate-checkout failure has a local boundary. Its documented respect_gitignore contract reads .gitignore files and does not currently read .git/info/exclude. Extending ordinary-file local-exclude support is a bounded deferred feature gap; no complete equivalence for that subfeature is claimed and no release-critical existing contract violation was established by this source review.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(entities): honor entity_languages in extraction filters (#2811) (#2881)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream applies entity_languages and user stopwords to its entity detector and closet metadata extractor. The fork does not ship that configurable language/entity-registry extraction pipeline; its existing symbol and KG extraction owners are unchanged.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): derive the Codex wing from the rollout's payload.cwd (#2908)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream derives hook wing routing from Codex rollout payload.cwd. The fork does not ship that hooks_cli rollout-to-wing owner. Its existing explicit project paths and packaged shell hooks are a different interface; no conversation workflow or provider-client scope is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(convo): select authored time by instant across UTC offsets (#2869)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream selects latest authored_at by parsed UTC instant across offsets. The fork conversation miner does not implement that authored_at-selection path; it preserves conversation text and records its existing filing metadata. No lexical-timestamp maximum in the corresponding fork path was found.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(miner): recognize registered entities in continuous CJK text (#2870)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream changes registered entity matching for continuous CJK text and variation selectors. The fork does not use this upstream registered-entity metadata matcher; its current parser/symbol and KG owners remain distinct.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: report effective embedding devices and document GPU support (#2872)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream reports effective accelerators and excludes CoreML where its Chroma MiniLM builder disables it. The fork canonical FastEmbed runtime explicitly uses CPU execution and has no upstream GPU/Chroma/EmbeddingGemma device-selection owner. Supported custom-model behavior remains within its existing separate extra and qualification boundary.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(mcp): hold the peer-writer lease per call, not per process (#2909)
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already takes and releases its palace write lease around each writing tool call through mempalace_code/mcp/runtime.py. Read calls do not retain a process-lifetime writer lease. Source inspection establishes per-call ownership. The named regression verifies release after a lease-body error; it does not exercise MCP transport.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: release embedder arena and freed heap after a mine (#2685) (#2893)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream releases its embedder arena and allocator heap after mining. The fork uses a different FastEmbed/ONNX embedding owner and cache lifecycle. This source change does not establish a corresponding fork regression or a measured RAM improvement; no memory-release or benchmark claim is made.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test: the pathname2url surrogate boundary is 3.12, not 3.13 (#2892)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream corrects a test-only Python-version boundary for pathname2url surrogate handling. The fork does not use this upstream test or its embedding path conversion owner; no runtime change is adopted.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): preserve valid filesystem path chars in shell stdin parsers (#2864)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream preserves filesystem path characters in Cursor and Antigravity shell stdin parsers. Those hook parsers are absent from the fork. Existing fork hook ownership remains unchanged.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): collapse <project>/.worktrees/<wt> into the project wing (#2586)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream collapses its project-local .worktrees directories into a project wing in its hook CLI. The fork uses a different hook/mining owner and does not import this wing identity rule.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(benchmarks): normalize LongMemEval NDCG against the full corpus (#2874)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream normalizes LongMemEval NDCG against the full corpus. The fork legacy LongMemEval harness requires an isolated ChromaDB environment and has no qualified text baseline. The default model is unchanged; this review neither qualifies that harness nor relaxes the independent code and text gates.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(entity): add generic code terms to English stopwords (#476) (#518)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream adds generic code terms to its English entity stopwords. The fork uses different parser/symbol and knowledge-graph extraction owners and does not import the upstream language stopword pipeline.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: release the request lock around a checkpoint's embedding phases (#2890)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream releases its global REQUEST_LOCK around checkpoint embedding phases. The fork has no corresponding checkpoint REQUEST_LOCK owner. This absence establishes inapplicability, without claiming equivalent checkpoint lock behavior.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: raise the MCP HTTP listen backlog above socketserver's default of 5 (#2889)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream increases its HTTP MCP server listen backlog. The fork exposes credential-free stdio MCP and has no corresponding HTTP listener or socket backlog.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(palace): lock the palace for writers with a different HOME (#2867)
delta_decisions.rationale: The local candidate adopts cross-HOME writer exclusion through the existing palace_write_lease owner with a permanent canonical-palace sibling anchor, while retaining the legacy HOME lease. The parent must exist and be usable; unsafe or unavailable anchors fail closed, without a HOME-only fallback. Existing safe regular single-link same-UID anchors are opened without content writes, truncation or removal, including read-only and nonempty anchors. Older different-HOME clients need an upgrade to participate. This is a local release candidate pending qualification, not a released behavior claim.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(storage): use OFD locks on Linux even when fcntl lacks F_OFD_SETLK (#2918)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream adds an OFD constant fallback to its in-process SQLite lock shim. The fork has no such backend and its writer fences use fcntl.flock, independently of F_OFD_SETLK.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test: clear the developer's own MemPalace env for the test session (#2912)
delta_decisions.rationale: The development candidate now snapshots and removes inherited product configuration before project imports, preserves explicit test and release harness controls, and restores the original environment through the existing session teardown. Independent synthetic modern and legacy overrides exposed the old escape without writing a palace; the subprocess regression covers isolation, test-set overrides and restoration. Qualification of the versioned release remains pending.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(chroma): don't quarantine HNSW segments under a live writer (#2906)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream protects Chroma HNSW quarantine beneath a live writer. Current fork packages reject Chroma and have no HNSW quarantine owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: Stop hook diary checkpoint always fails on sqlite_exact backend: "attempt to write a readonly database" (#2898)
delta_decisions.rationale: The upstream checkpoint path and sqlite_exact handle promotion are absent locally. The local MCP diary writer already owns its embedding write lease; no upstream hook or backend is introduced.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Forward mempalace sync to the live hub (#2919)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream forwards sync through its live HTTP hub. This fork exposes local CLI and stdio MCP, with no corresponding live hub or network forwarding owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(kg): dedupe identical closed-interval add_triple replays (#2605)
delta_decisions.rationale: The local knowledge graph already returns the existing identifier for identical subject, predicate, object and closed validity window. This resolves the reported replay duplicate. Full identity semantics differ intentionally: upstream includes confidence and provenance, while the local documented identity ignores those fields. No durable contract is changed.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Docs: OpenClaw Skill Update (#2237)
delta_decisions.rationale: The upstream integration instructions target light and full upstream tools, HTTP hubs, supersede and hook capabilities absent from this package. Copying them would introduce unsupported claims; the existing portable minimal memory plugin remains its owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(recall): also listen on agent/created, so memory reaches DSH 0.2.x sessions (#2876)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream adds the agent-created event and bounded retry behavior to its DSH plugin. This fork has no DSH plugin owner; no new integration is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: docs(changelog): fold Wave 1-3 3.12.0 fixes and PR list into [3.12.0] (#2920)
delta_decisions.rationale: This consolidates upstream 3.12.0 release notes and references. The comparison records that upstream release description; upstream feature and release claims are not copied into the fork release notes.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(mcp): treat only upper-case PQL clause keywords as keywords
delta_decisions.rationale: Fork has no upstream PQL parser; search accepts literal text through local search owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2; chore(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2; chore(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0
delta_decisions.rationale: Updates upstream-only release-native and Docker workflow action pins; this fork has separate release owners.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): report a checkpoint queued behind a running mine as queued, not failed; docs(hooks): drop the issue number from the queued checkpoint comment
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream save-hook queued checkpoint behavior; fork has no equivalent save-hook queue.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(llm): retry reasoning models without the parameters they reject (#2914)
delta_decisions.rationale: Reasoning-model request parameters and token budget apply to absent external LLM client/closet pipeline.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: land Tier 1 release-blocker fixes before v3.12.0 (#2860) (#2938)
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already reads identity as UTF-8; BOM-specific handling remains a minor deferred difference. Legacy maintenance artifact families, Chroma rebuild clients and logstream replica preservation target absent owners. Upstream MCP canonical wing slugs differ from the local taxonomy identity contract, so no normalization migration is adopted.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): clean up convos mine PID slot and bound shutdown (#2917); fix(hooks): supervise mine shutdown outside the interpreter
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream hook PID cleanup/interpreter exit watchdog; fork watcher has independent lifetime, not upstream hook supervisor.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(miner): validate the wing from mempalace.yaml; fix(config): link a stored wing whose prefix only shows once slugged; fix(miner): validate room names from mempalace.yaml (#2951)
delta_decisions.rationale: Upstream YAML canonical slugs differ from fork validation and taxonomy identities. Fork config/mining owners must retain documented names; no normalization migration is authorized.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(chroma): quarantine HNSW metadata only after stability checks (#2897)
delta_decisions.rationale: Chroma HNSW metadata quarantine owner is retired from fork.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix: close five pre-release security gaps found in the 3.12 audit
delta_decisions.rationale: The applicable repeated-** denial-of-service correction is adopted in the existing GitignoreMatcher._match_from_root owner with iterative rolling-state matching, bounded work and no recursive depth. Local source commit 480cce1612d02d8e2023aac19b3f7fffe1c8f0f6 passed independent review; 11 focused gitignore checks passed, including 3,885 old-semantics comparisons and deep inputs. The old matcher fails the deterministic bound at 521 comparisons versus 520. Init YAML/entities writers already refuse symlinks and preserve regular destination mode; this fork does not append project .gitignore. Credentialed HTTP clients, Qdrant, remote logstream/SSE, Antigravity and Chroma lock-holder owners are absent. Fallback Python module launch commands remain unchanged: attacker-controlled working-directory reachability is unknown and deferred for a bounded follow-up. No blanket child-import safety is claimed; that uncertainty does not establish a current candidate acceptance violation.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: test: let communicate() close the lock holder's stdin
delta_decisions.rationale: Test-only stdin closure for upstream Chroma lock holder absent here.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(layers): fence stored memory in wake-up and Hermes prompts (#2946)
delta_decisions.rationale: The applicable wake-up trust boundary is adopted in mempalace_code/layers.py at local source commit 480cce1612d02d8e2023aac19b3f7fffe1c8f0f6, independently reviewed. L1 stored reference text is fenced deterministically, hostile display labels are bounded to one line and stored drawers stay unchanged. The existing output budget is preserved. All 36 focused layer checks passed, including actual wake-up CLI behavior. Hermes integration is absent; no external client or model is introduced.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(security): close three gaps the review of the release blockers found
delta_decisions.rationale: The existing room_detector_local.validate_regular_destination/write_regular_destination owner uses lstat, temporary publication and the existing file mode. This covers the regular-file mode regression while preserving symlink refusal. Antigravity helper imports and replicated logstream HLC validation target absent owners; no new hook or coordination route is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: chore(deps): bump locked packages with published advisories
delta_decisions.rationale: Only the upstream uv.lock resolver output changes. This fork has independent dependency floors and its own release resolver audit; upstream locked versions neither change nor qualify the fork dependency set.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(hooks): file the save-hook diary checkpoint through a live hub; ci: re-trigger checks for #2625
delta_decisions.rationale: Live HTTP hub save-hook forwarding is absent from local CLI/stdin MCP fork.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: fix(repair): gate the from-sqlite rebuild on FTS5's own integrity check
delta_decisions.rationale: FTS5 Chroma rebuild integrity gates target retired backend, not LanceDB storage.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Run upstream CI with pytest-xdist loadfile workers and cancel superseded PR runs.
delta_decisions.rationale: Optional upstream CI performance change. The fork has independent release-required jobs and runner qualification; no current release acceptance requires parallel tests or cancellation changes.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Refuse incidental DNS lookups in upstream tests and use literal embedding endpoint addresses.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fixture patches upstream llm_client._resolves_private and OpenAICompatEmbeddingFunction tests. The fork has neither owner and keeps local FastEmbed/ONNX embeddings. This tail changes no runtime implementation or security guard.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Codex response_item-only conversation fallback, user-text filtering, subagent exclusion and hook turn counting.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork retains event_msg-only conversation support and explicitly refuses a recognized rollout without a complete supported conversation. This format extension is deferred. Replacing a previously indexed source at the same path with an unsupported rollout can remove prior source-owned conversation drawers for that source, wing and extraction mode. Manual, diary, project and KG data are outside this removal path. Raw source bytes remain unchanged; recovery of former stored content is not proven. The merge also carries already-reviewed test and changelog changes. Independent review found no established release acceptance obligation violated by retaining the existing refusal/replacement contract.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Anthropic request temperature, output budget and truncation reporting.
delta_decisions.rationale: The upstream AnthropicProvider and external LLM closet/request pipeline are absent from the fork. Topic and merge patches introduce no corresponding fork owner or integration; the existing reasoning-model-client boundary remains unchanged.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Share the no-reverse-DNS server bind between the upstream daemon and HTTP MCP.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork exposes stdio MCP through its existing launcher and dispatcher. The upstream HTTP hub and daemon server owners are absent. The integration merge carries previously reviewed test, CI and Anthropic changes and introduces no distinct fork behavior.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Upstream test timing, Windows scratch paths, Ollama fixtures, junction setup, dsh retry handshakes and Chroma lock test synchronization.
delta_decisions.rationale: The complete primary patches change tests and CI only, including an empty CI retrigger. dsh and Chroma backend owners are absent from the fork. No installed runtime, LanceDB storage/recovery owner, inference-memory bound, L1 trust boundary or scanner guard changes.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Reorganize upstream 3.12.0 changelog entries and move the HTTP reverse-DNS note into that release.
delta_decisions.rationale: Topic and merge patches change CHANGELOG.md only. Historical PR and dependency references add no implementation, security guard, recovery behavior or fork release contract.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Exercise process-scoped HTTP writer-lease release after requests and failures.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork uses a per-call palace writer lease in mempalace_code/mcp/runtime.py and has no HTTP transport. The existing operation-lock regression proves lease release after a body error. These upstream tests add coverage of their HTTP owner without changing the fork lease contract.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Document ProcessType and provide a macOS LaunchAgent for the upstream server.
delta_decisions.rationale: The template launches the upstream hub/server. Fork watcher schedules are owned by mempalace_code/watcher.py and the installed launchd lifecycle owner. The upstream daemon template is outside that interface.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Track verified source fingerprints, incomplete snapshots, chunker revisions, source-directory identity and bounded reads during conversation mining.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already computes BLAKE2b over raw source bytes and scopes stored state by wing, ingest_mode and extract_mode in mempalace_code/convo_miner.py. This detects same-size edits with restored mtime on the next scan. It reads bytes for hashing and normalization separately and does not provide the new upstream before/after-fstat snapshot guarantee. Growing-source races and a configurable transcript byte cap remain residual gaps. Existing full replacement and read-error preservation behavior stays explicit. Topic-branch merges bring previously reviewed develop changes into this branch; the final owner patches and recorded first-parent patch inventory were reviewed. This decision does not claim equivalent snapshot preservation or journal recovery.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Add the Antigravity Marketplace bundle and sidecar with hub-proxied pagination, lazy vectors and corrected recency ordering.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork ships a portable CLI/stdio agent plugin and has no Antigravity sidecar, upstream hub proxy, Chroma SQLite recency path or web UI. The associated Chroma fallback ordering fixes target those absent owners.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Isolate Antigravity Node hooks, Chroma warnings and the armed mine-watchdog test.
delta_decisions.rationale: These changes affect upstream tests for absent Antigravity hooks, Chroma warning filtering and the upstream mine watchdog. Fork pytest environment isolation and current tests remain independently owned. No runtime change is inferred from these fixtures.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Preserve canonical KG entity names on legacy import and repair Chroma escaped-text filtering and HTTP embedding lifecycle regressions.
delta_decisions.rationale: Fork KG imports use _merge_import in mempalace_code/knowledge_graph.py with a transaction and preflight collision checks. Existing regressions require collision refusals to preserve every row and to be atomic within new batches. This preserves identity by refusal while upstream reports and skips unresolved imports. Chroma escaped-document storage and upstream HTTP embedding lease hooks have no fork counterparts.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Index logical SQLite drawer lookup and use UNION ALL for parent-key candidates.
delta_decisions.rationale: The current fork storage backend is LanceDB. The upstream SQLite-exact backend and its parent/drawer schema are absent, so query-plan changes do not apply.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Update Docker login action to 4.8.0 and setup-python to 7.1.0.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no Docker publish workflow. Its existing setup-python pin is already v7.1.0, covered by the completed dependency-fix CI. Upstream workflow ownership and release-native jobs remain independent.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Journal conversation and diary text before re-mine upserts and prunes, scope producer ownership and preserve journal directory permissions.
delta_decisions.rationale: Fork conversation replacement deliberately upserts changed drawers and removes stale source-owned IDs. It preserves manual/project/diary rows through wing and ingest-mode filtering but has no drawer_revisions.jsonl owner or recovery contract for overwritten text. The existing backup owner is separate from per-write journaling. RFC 007 introduces a durable journal and deletion lifecycle; adopting that state owner requires its own scoped design and migration acceptance. Prior-text recovery after replacement remains unproven in this release. Only synthetic fixtures were inspected.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Cap BLAS threads at actual server entry points, preserve the real MCP module and keep lightweight paths lazy.
delta_decisions.rationale: The final upstream patch removes import-time environment mutation and caps threads in its server/proxy/sidecar entry points. The fork has its own FastEmbed/ONNX runtime, official-SDK stdio launcher and no lightweight HTTP server. Its measured inference batch-memory fix is retained. No measured fork thread-contention acceptance gap justifies new environment mutation or an embedder-cache lifecycle. The mock get_collection compatibility fix targets the absent upstream searcher package.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Serve the three-tool lightweight MCP catalog over hub HTTP while preserving stdio stdout.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork exposes named stdio tool profiles through the official MCP SDK. It has no upstream hub HTTP transport or PQL facade. Adding a transport and authentication surface is outside this release comparison.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Retry whole SQLite operations with fresh cached connections, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and explicit cached-KG close.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork opens operation-local SQLite connections, uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE for writes and imports, and retries bounded WAL initialization. Existing concurrent collision and fresh-database tests cover that local owner. Upstream adds operation-wide retry decorators and cached connection lifecycle management. Those broader retry semantics are not claimed by the fork and are deferred pending a reproduced gap through its operation-local path.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Carry revision journals and palace-owned state into Chroma-source rebuilds and create rebuilt destinations privately.
delta_decisions.rationale: Fork full repair replaces only lance/ through _save_and_swap in mempalace_code/cli_commands/maintenance.py. Every other existing palace entry remains in place and is also copied to the recovery backup. Existing KG/state-sidecar preservation and repeated-backup regressions cover that owner. The fork refuses missing and retired Chroma palaces, so the upstream fresh Chroma-destination creation route is absent. This decision concerns sidecar preservation; it does not claim the upstream rebuild algorithm or add a revision-journal workflow.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Count Stop-hook transcript messages through a verified append cursor, anchor the complete last line and skip over-deep JSON lines.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no mempalace.hooks_cli or transcript_cursor owner and does not consume the upstream Stop-hook transcript counter. Its optional conversation-save hooks are a separate interface. This upstream-only cursor optimization does not change supported fork mining or stdio behavior, and no conversation persistence or hook workflow is added.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Explain that an existing source is a file when a directory-only mining mode rejects it.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork tool_mine accepts a directory argument and returns success=false with Path is not a directory before starting the miner when a regular file is supplied. The existing file-path refusal regression exercises this typed MCP owner. Upstream mode selection and single-file convos routing are separate interfaces and are not copied.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Drop the response_format hint on retry and later requests when an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint rejects JSON mode.
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no upstream LLM client, external classification endpoint or response_format request path. Default embeddings remain local FastEmbed/ONNX; optional custom embedding models do not implement this LLM classification client. No provider request, fallback route or external-model capability is introduced.
